evidence: Study assumptions for comparison. Programme fractions and the domeless end state are adopted separately in habitation/crater_gardens/buildout.json. These choices do not establish an optimal site ranking or a qualified enclosure.

selection.rule: Rank eventual candidates by binned absolute deviation from the representative depth/diameter ratio, with a SHA-256 identifier tie-break. Accept in that order while keeping circular estates disjoint. For the initial subset, choose sites in the adopted 500–1,000-resident representative architectural band in regional groups: seed order favours more neighbours within 25 km, then geometry and identifier; each group retains its seed and up to 63 remaining neighbours ordered by diameter band, geometry and identifier. Compare with the globally smallest-span subset. Both are subsets of the reference eventual selection.

enclosure.gas_description: Dry air molar mass used for inventory; the operating composition, humidity and oxygen partial pressure need their own life-support design.
enclosure.material_status: Hypothetical effective tensile allowable and density; no selected laminate, joint design, creep life or safety factor. Equivalent membrane thickness is a pressure-only analytical comparison.
enclosure.volume_status: Spherical cap plus paraboloid bowl; gross volume before buildings, water and earthworks displace gas.
enclosure.architecture: Initial communities each occupy one contiguous dome with their eventual lifestyle and layout substantially in place. Module comparisons apply to larger communities only.
enclosure.improvement_status: Reference, developed and upper effective-allowable sensitivities at fixed assumed density. Current fiber and directional coupon strengths motivate the comparison; no biaxial shell, joints, ageing life or maintenance reduction is validated by those strengths.

operation.status: Duration, leakage, replacement lives and service loads are sensitivities, not forecasts or measured settlement performance. Night means half a synodic month. Radiators assume shaded unobstructed cold sky. Water throughput is assumed; the recovery fraction is an ISS precedent within its measured processing boundary. Food, industrial process heat, agriculture and lake losses require separate service accounts.

transport.status: 10 km/h is an exploration-rover concept comparison; 40 km/h improved roads and 150 km/h regional rail are assumed infrastructure cases. Times include ideal acceleration and braking but exclude stops, docking, terrain, rescue margins and traffic. A spherical minimum spanning tree supplies a direct-distance network comparison; its links are not engineered routes.
